The Truth About Claude

Tired of "AI Gurus" selling fake buzzwords and unnecessary fluff?

If you've watched online coaches claim they built an entire lead machine "for free in seconds using Claude," let's clear the air right now. Join my upcoming short class where we cut through the hype and run live tasks on screen.

The Guru Myth: "You Need Claude CoWork & Claude Design"

The Truth: Those are free downloads, but they add technical complexity that realtors simply do not need to worry about. Coaches overcomplicate basic AI setup to make standard prompting look like rocket science.

The Guru Myth: "It Takes Seconds & Secret Custom Skills"

The Truth: You don't need proprietary "skills" or "brain builders." Any agent can clone their market persona by simply chatting naturally with Claude or using a standard Claude Project for free.

The Missing Piece: Actual Integration (Krowd)

The Truth: A text outline inside a chatbot isn't automation. It can't post to Facebook, sync with your MLS, or text leads 24/7. Krowd is the missing engine that actually connects AI to your real estate pipeline.

Prompt Used To Generate Package:

View Full Prompt Instructions

Build a complete relocation lead-magnet package for Oneida County, NY. I want four connected deliverables, using the Marketing Media Manager tools. Do not use any Krowd Real Estate MLS tools.

Use my logo https://krowdimg.b-cdn.net/Elite%20Home/logo.png

PDF Relocation Guide: Create a genuinely useful Oneida County relocation guide people will happily trade their email for. Cover: why people are moving to the area (honest, not salesy), what it actually costs to live/buy here right now with price bands by community, a decoded map of the main towns and villages (New Hartford, Utica, Rome, Whitesboro, Clinton, Sherrill, Vernon, etc.) and which lifestyle each fits, commuting and getting around, schools and family life, things to do year-round, and a short "first month here" checklist. Pull my voice, proof points, USP, and any local price data from my brain file. Include an About Me page and a clear CTA to book a call. Generate the guide as a polished, designed image/PDF asset ready to hand out.

Landing Page: Build a landing page that offers the guide in exchange for name + email. Headline and copy should match my brand voice. Include a contact form wired to capture submissions, and set it up so submitting the form delivers the guide. Deploy it (GitHub Pages hosting) and give me the live URL.

Comment Automation: Create a Facebook/Instagram comment automation: when someone comments a trigger keyword on my relocation posts, auto-reply publicly and DM them the link to the landing page so they can grab the guide. This should be done on the elite Home Group Demo FB & IG Page. Make sure the button for the DM is point to the GitHub Pages landing page.

GMB Post: Create a google my business Post offering the guide and give a link to the GitHub Pages landing page.

Follow-Up Sequence: Set up an automated follow-up for everyone who opts in through the landing page. Create an email and/or SMS broadcast sequence that delivers the guide first, then nurtures them over the following days — a short welcome, a value-add touch, and a soft CTA to book a relocation call. Match my brand voice and keep it warm, not pushy. Trigger it off the form submission so new leads flow into it automatically.
